# Each test starts from state of its own, and what the last test's tree does
# as it is taken down lands in the last test's state, not the next one's.
#
# android shows each test's model in one composition and made the next
# model before the last one's was disposed: a new MainScreenState is the
# file's `state`, which greeter reads, so the `@unmount` greeter ran as the
# composition moved on pushed "-a" onto the second test's log.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var log list[string] = []

component greeter(name string) ui.node {
    effect(@mount { log.push("+" + name) }, @unmount { log.push("-" + name) })
    ui.text(value=name)
}

component app ui.node {
    var shown = true

    ui.vbox {
        if shown {
            greeter(name="a")
        }
    }
}

func testTheFirstSeesItsOwnMounts(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(log.format(",") == "+a")
}

func testTheSecondSeesNoUnmountOfTheFirst(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(log.format(",") == "+a")
}
